news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹31.99 (vs ₹11.70 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹31.99 (up from ₹11.70 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹6.65b (up 68% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹895.2m (up 174% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 14% (up from 8.3% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 130% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 197% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
